shots.seen: A man in dark clothing walks from behind toward a large dark block structure in a low-poly city at dusk.
A man seen from behind walks along a grey street past blocky dark buildings with glowing yellow windows.
A man stands facing the camera from the waist up outside a grey building with three yellow cubes by a doorway.

overall: Neither the third-person view nor the visual style is fully consistent, as several shots crop the man's legs or turn him toward the camera, and shot 4 shifts from low-poly grey-box to a more realistic look. The biggest weakness is that the barren geometric environments rarely depict the rich, specific imagery described in the spoken lines.
